en.name: Rendang paste
en.summary: Rendang paste is a rempah: ground fresh shallot, garlic, ginger, galangal, turmeric and chilli, usually sitting under oil. Unopened jars keep about 2 years in the cupboard. Once opened it is a fresh-aromatic paste with about 5 days in the fridge, or about 3 months frozen.
en.pantry: Unopened jars and sachets keep to the printed date in a cool dark cupboard, about 2 years from purchase — a figure taken from Thai red curry paste, which is made the same way and is the closest product with a published number. Keep them away from the hob and out of the sun. After opening, the cupboard is not an option: fresh low-acid produce under oil is exactly the combination that carries a botulism risk at room temperature, and botulinum toxin cannot be seen, smelled or tasted.
en.fridge: Refrigerate once opened, at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, and use within about 5 days — the published figure for the equivalent Thai curry paste. The closest hazard analogue, garlic in oil, is held to an even tighter limit, so do not treat this as a soft number. Use a clean dry spoon, level the surface and keep the oil film over it. Homemade bumbu is the same or shorter.
en.freezer: Freezing is how this paste should be kept: about 3 months at −18 °C (0 °F), since garlic in oil may be frozen for up to several months. Homemade bumbu is much better frozen than refrigerated, and a paste that has been fried off first keeps its flavour through it. Freeze it in tablespoon portions in an ice-cube tray, then bag the cubes so you take out only what a pot needs.
en.thawing: Drop a frozen cube straight into a hot pan, where it melts and fries from frozen, or thaw it in the fridge and use it the same day. Never leave it out at room temperature.
spoilage: Mould on the surface or on pieces standing above the oil
Gas, bubbling or a domed lid — discard without tasting
A rancid, crayon-like smell from the oil
A fermented or yeasty smell instead of a fresh, sharp, aromatic one
tips: Freeze the jar in cubes the day you open it; the fridge window is very short.
Fry the paste before freezing if you have time — deeper flavour and less water.
Never judge an oil-covered paste by how it looks; botulinum toxin is invisible and has no smell.
The finished rendang is a different food — dry-cooked, it keeps far better than the raw paste.

faq.q: How long does rendang paste last once opened?
faq.a: About 5 days refrigerated at 4 °C or below. That figure comes from Thai curry paste; no agency publishes one for rendang paste.
Yes, and you should. Tablespoon cubes at −18 °C for about 3 months, ideally fried off first.

faq.q: How long does an unopened jar keep?
faq.a: About 2 years in a cool dark cupboard, to the printed date.

faq.q: Is the oil on top of the paste protecting it?
faq.a: No. Oil over fresh low-acid aromatics excludes oxygen, which is the condition botulinum bacteria need. Keep opened paste cold or frozen.

zh.name: 仁當醬
zh.summary: 仁當醬是一種 rempah：把新鮮紅蔥、蒜、薑、南薑、薑黃和辣椒磨成醬，通常浸在油下。未開封的罐裝放櫥櫃大約 2 年。開封後它就是新鮮辛香料醬，冷藏大約 5 天，冷凍大約 3 個月。
zh.pantry: 未開封的玻璃罐和調理包放在陰涼避光的櫥櫃，到標示日期為止，從購買日起算大約 2 年——這個數字取自泰式紅咖哩醬，兩者做法相同，也是最接近且有公布數字的產品。請遠離爐火、避免日曬。開封之後，櫥櫃就不是選項：新鮮低酸性食材浸在油裡，正是在室溫下帶有肉毒桿菌風險的組合，而肉毒桿菌毒素看不到、聞不到、也嚐不出來。
zh.fridge: 開封後請放 4 °C 以下冷藏，並在大約 5 天內用完——這是同類型泰式咖哩醬公布的數字。最接近的風險對照組「蒜頭泡油」被要求得更嚴格，所以這個數字不是可以隨便延長的。請用乾淨乾燥的湯匙，把表面抹平，並保持油膜覆蓋。自製 bumbu 一樣或更短。
zh.freezer: 冷凍才是這種醬應有的保存方式：在 −18 °C 大約 3 個月，因為蒜頭泡油可以冷凍保存數個月。自製 bumbu 冷凍遠優於冷藏，而先炒香再冷凍能把風味保留得更好。請用製冰盒以一大匙為單位冷凍，凍硬後裝袋，每次只取一鍋要用的量。
zh.thawing: 直接把冷凍醬塊丟進熱鍋，它會邊化邊炒香；也可以放冷藏解凍並在當天用完。絕對不要放室溫退冰。
spoilage: 醬面或露出油面的料塊長霉
產氣、冒泡或蓋子鼓起——不要試吃，直接丟掉
油發出油耗味或蠟筆味
聞起來有發酵味或酵母味，而不是新鮮嗆香的氣味
tips: 開罐當天就分裝成小塊冷凍；冷藏窗口非常短。
有時間就先炒香再冷凍——風味更深、水分更少。
絕對不要用外觀判斷油封的醬；肉毒桿菌毒素無色無味。
煮好的仁當是另一回事——乾式收乾後比生醬耐放得多。

faq.q: 仁當醬開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 放 4 °C 以下冷藏大約 5 天。這個數字來自泰式咖哩醬，仁當醬本身沒有機構公布的數字。
可以，而且建議這麼做。以一大匙為單位在 −18 °C 冷凍大約 3 個月，先炒香更好。

faq.q: 未開封的仁當醬可以放多久？
faq.a: 陰涼避光的櫥櫃大約 2 年，以標示日期為準。

faq.q: 上面那層油有保護作用嗎？
faq.a: 沒有。油蓋在新鮮低酸性辛香料上是隔絕氧氣，而那正是肉毒桿菌需要的條件。開封後請冷藏或冷凍。
